newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel falls below S$2.50 support.
newsitem.headline: SingTel falls below S$2.50 support.

text.p: Shares in Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) fell below a major support level of Singapore $2.50 in active trade on Monday, dealers said.
At 0145 GMT, the shares hit a new year low at S$2.45, down S$0.06, with more than two million shares traded.
Dealers said the volume included several block trades around S2.52 totalling more than one million shares.
"A lot of foreign funds are still selling SingTel," said a broker with a local firm. He said the stock could see some support at S$2.30-S$2.32.
SingTel shares have been falling since it lost its monoploy in the Singapore mobile phones and paging markets on April 1, 1997.
